title: The Necessary Aftermath
author: Ada Delacroix
blurb: Elodie Eastwick, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
